svg.text: Two kinds of thing (Koda): what's on the outside changes the ship's shape; what's inside you wouldn't see on a ship flying by. So two pictures: the ship as it flies, and the ship opened up.
ON THE OUTSIDE: THREE STEPS OF EACH
Twin white rails with a breech,
small against so big a ship.
Round ports set into the pods;
White dots on the hull's edge,
The hull's own outline, fat and
blue, behind the ship: it wraps it
Plating cut to the hull's shape,
they hold the capacitors. No cone
WHOLE SHIPS: AS THEY FLY, AND OPENED UP
opened up: holds and drone bays, bots, capacitors
